text: The implemented PR/nightly/championship workflows, fail-closed plan/receipt checks, baseline-receipt guard, and allocation ratchet remain green. The final query-overlay run used 15,000 training columns and measured 22,609.9 allocated bytes/query with a 636,408-byte worst interval, below the 100,000-byte mean and 1,000,000-byte peak ceilings; exact checksum 14,560,000. Dependency on an admitted championship baseline still prevents closure.
